newsitem.title: LATVIA: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 25.
newsitem.headline: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 25.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by the Radio Latvia at early afternoon on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot ouch for their accuracy.
- Loans worth $54.5 million channeled through the now insolvent Lata International company cannot be recovered and will have to be repaid by tax payers, the state audit says.
- Latvian senior citizens' congress voices worries about growing social tax debt and calls for stricter measures to be taken against tax-dodgers.
- Lattelecom wants to balance local and foreign tariffs, the company's COF Peter Martin says. Lattelecom currently has to subsidize local calls by charging more for foreign connections.
